text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The final stop of the Triple Tiara, the Shuka Sho, is here. Mejiro Dober is so focused, even the cheers of the crowd don't faze her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before the race, Mejiro Dober passionately declares that she will show everyone just how much she's improved in the Triple Tiara!
